name: tab09
definition: 业务主记录 Counterexample: 与同族成员表（如 tab06、tab07、tab08、tab11、tab13）区分：这些是同一业务实体的不同副本/层级，不单独建对象 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab09; provenance: direct source tab09

name: tab01
definition: 业务明细记录 Counterexample: 与 tab02 区分：tab02 为另一业务记录表，仅共享部分列 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 业务关联记录 Counterexample: 与 tab01 区分：列集合不同，仅共享 fld003/fld009 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 业务扩展记录 Counterexample: 与 tab09 区分：tab09 为表族代表，tab03 为独立列集合的扩展记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务分类记录 Counterexample: 与 tab05 区分：tab04 仅含分类键与主键，tab05 含更多业务列 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05

scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: tab06

scope: Records of table tab06; provenance: direct source tab06

name: tab07

scope: Records of table tab07; provenance: direct source tab07

name: tab08
definition: 业务子记录（副本三） Counterexample: 与 tab07 区分：首列不同，其余列高度重叠 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab08; provenance: direct source tab08

name: tab11
definition: 业务子记录（副本四） Counterexample: 与 tab13 区分：tab13 列更多，tab11 为较窄副本 Maturity: Provisional

name: tab12
definition: 业务关联明细 Counterexample: 与 tab06 区分：tab12 为关联明细，仅两列 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab12; provenance: direct source tab12

name: tab13
definition: 业务综合记录 Counterexample: 与 tab09 区分：tab13 列更全，但同属表族，不单独建对象 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab13; provenance: direct source tab13

name: Driver
definition: A person competing in Formula 1 races, identified by forename and surname.

name: DriverSurname
definition: The family name of a driver.

name: DriverReferenceName
definition: Short reference code identifying a driver.

name: DriverNationality
definition: The nationality of a driver.

name: DriverDateOfBirth
definition: The birth date of a driver.

name: DriverWebsite
definition: The introduction website URL of a driver.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 team/constructor.

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: The nationality of a constructor.

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 race event.

name: RaceYear
definition: The year in which a race took place.

name: RaceDate
definition: The date on which a race took place.

name: RaceNumber
definition: The numeric identifier of a race.

name: Circuit
definition: The circuit where a race is held.

name: CircuitCountry
definition: The country where a circuit is located.

name: CircuitLatitude
definition: The latitude coordinate of a circuit.

name: CircuitLongitude
definition: The longitude coordinate of a circuit.

name: RaceResultPosition
definition: The finishing position of a driver in a race.

name: RaceResultPoints
definition: The championship points scored by a driver/constructor in a race.

name: RaceResultFinishTime
definition: The recorded finish/lap time of a driver in a race.
scope: tab13 where fld024 IS NOT NULL

name: RaceResultLapSpeed
definition: The fastest lap speed recorded by a driver in a race.

name: RaceResultAccidents
definition: Count of accidents recorded for a driver in a race.

name: QualifyingQ1Time
definition: The time recorded in the first qualifying period.

name: PitStopDuration
definition: The duration of a pit stop.

name: DriverRaceParticipation
definition: Count of races a driver participated in.

name: AveragePitStopDuration
definition: Average duration of pit stops for a driver. Formula: AVG(PitStopDuration). Inputs: PitStopDuration = tab12.fld041

name: PointsPerRace
definition: Average points scored per race. Formula: SUM(RaceResultPoints) / COUNT(RaceNumber). Inputs: RaceResultPoints = tab13.fld026; RaceNumber = tab05.fld021

name: ChampionVsLastPercentageFaster
definition: Percentage by which champion's finish time is faster than last finisher. Formula: (RaceResultFinishTime_last - RaceResultFinishTime_champion) / RaceResultFinishTime_last * 100. Inputs: RaceResultFinishTime = tab13.fld024 WHERE fld024 IS NOT NULL

name: NonFirstTrackPercentage
definition: Share of races where driver was not at track position 1. Formula: COUNT(RaceNumber WHERE RaceResultPosition > 1) / COUNT(RaceNumber). Inputs: RaceResultPosition = tab13.fld029; RaceNumber = tab05.fld021

name: DriverRaceCount
definition: Total races a driver participated in. Formula: COUNT(RaceNumber). Inputs: RaceNumber = tab05.fld021

name: MaxPoints
definition: Maximum points scored. Formula: MAX(RaceResultPoints). Inputs: RaceResultPoints = tab13.fld026

name: FastestLapSpeed
definition: Maximum lap speed among drivers. Formula: MAX(RaceResultLapSpeed). Inputs: RaceResultLapSpeed = tab13.fld049

name: AccidentCount
definition: Count of accident records for a driver. Formula: COUNT(RaceResultAccidents). Inputs: RaceResultAccidents = tab13.fld041 WHERE fld041 = 3

name: DriverAge
definition: Age of driver derived from birth date relative to race date. Formula: RaceDate - DriverDateOfBirth. Inputs: RaceDate = tab05.fld023; DriverDateOfBirth = tab03.fld019

name: ConstructorTotalPoints
definition: Total points scored by a constructor. Formula: SUM(RaceResultPoints). Inputs: RaceResultPoints = tab13.fld026

name: RaceResults
definition: Answers finishing position, points, finish time and lap speed per race.

name: Accidents
definition: Answers accident counts per driver/race.

name: PitStops
definition: Answers pit stop durations and averages.
